events.title: Thanks for 200k wishlists!!
events.summary: Hey gang, We just wanted to say a huge thank you for the 200,000 wishlists (and counting!) 🤯 We’re so thrilled to see so many of you are excited about our game! The other good news is that you don’t have much longer to wait as Queen’s Domain is out on the 30th of October, which is just 11 days away!Our demo is also included in Steam Next Fest which has just kicked off so be sure to check it out if you haven’t already! See you on the 30th and happy next festing!Freshly Baked 🍞

events.title: Queen’s Domain will be yours on October 30th!
events.summary: Hey folks, We’re so excited to announce that we are launching Queen’s Domain on October 30th! You can watch our brand new release date (and also console reveal!) trailer announcing the news here: After years working on this thing we're nearly there now, and we can’t wait to see you on the 30th.-Freshly Baked 🍞

events.title: Over 100k wishlists! THANK YOU!
events.summary: Hey there! It’s almost been two months since we announced and dropped our demo at the PC Gaming Show. We can’t believe how much has happened since!Over 100,000 people have wishlisted Queen’s Domain (wow!!!) Thank you to everyone who has checked out the demo, provided feedback and ideas, and wishlisted the game! Wishlisting helps us so much as a small dev duo. Feel free to join our Discord to keep in the loop for news and share how many times the eye plants got you 👁️ Thanks again,Freshly Baked 🍞

events.title: Demo 1.0.3 hotfix
events.summary: Fixed a bug with language selection when using a controllerDecreased minimum brightness value to prevent making the menu impossible to seeHolding the run key while in the air no longer drains staminaFixed regen life point abilities not clearing the low life point screen effectFixed minimum damage on hit to match the power bar

events.title: Demo 1.0.2 hotfix
events.summary: Fixed a bug where you could stuck on certain objects collisions very rarelyFixed a bug where you could be returned to the wrong position after falling into waterCleaned up handling of inputs on chargeable secondary attacks

events.title: Demo Version 1.0.1 hotfix
events.summary: Huge thanks to everyone who tried out the demo yesterday, doing our best to fix the bugs you've found so far!Fixed a bug that caused enemies killed before death to not respawn on continuePossible fixes for a crash bugs - we haven't been able to repro these locally but have tried a couple potential fixes based on crash logs Fixed life point display rounding errorFixed a typo in roasted ojum lizard item descriptionFixed sticky sprint bug when falling in waterFixed issue where description in bestia

events.title: Queen's Domain fully revealed in PC Gaming Show & demo out now!
events.summary: Hey there! We are Freshly Baked Games and this is our brand new game Queen’s Domain!!👑 We were lucky enough to announce and drop our demo during tonight’s PC Gaming Show Most Wanted, so if you’re joining us from there, hi 👋If you missed it, don’t worry! You can check it out here !!!! Let us introduce ourselves:🌎 We are a dev duo based in the states🐈 We bonded over a shared love for Fromsoft, Zelda, anime and cats🎮 We met working at a game studio from 2017 before deciding to leave and work togeth
